description: This file contains the implementation of HTTP handlers for UI-related reasoner operations in a distributed agent framework. It includes endpoints for listing all reasoners, retrieving details, performance metrics, execution history, templates, and streaming real-time events via server-sent events (SSE). The handlers interact with internal storage and event bus components to serve dynamic data about reasoners across nodes.

classes.name: ReasonersHandler
classes.description: Struct providing methods to handle reasoner-related HTTP requests, encapsulating dependencies on storage and event systems.

classes.name: ReasonerWithNode
classes.description: Data structure combining reasoner info with node context for responses.

methods.name: GetAllReasonersHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a paginated, filtered list of all reasoners across nodes, with online/offline filtering and search.

methods.name: GetReasonerDetailsHandler
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific reasoner identified by node and reasoner ID.

methods.name: GetPerformanceMetricsHandler
methods.description: Fetches performance metrics for a specific reasoner.

methods.name: GetExecutionHistoryHandler
methods.description: Provides paginated execution history records for a specific reasoner.

methods.name: GetExecutionTemplatesHandler
methods.description: Returns mock data for execution templates associated with the reasoner.

methods.name: SaveExecutionTemplateHandler
methods.description: Accepts JSON to save a new execution template (currently mock implementation).

methods.name: StreamReasonerEventsHandler
methods.description: Establishes a server-sent events stream to relay real-time reasoner events and heartbeats to the UI client.
